record_title: Exact 2-adic valuations for the tenth power of the Thue--Morse generating function
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The theorem treats only the exact 2-adic valuation for the tenth power and does not establish odd-part automaticity or a general-exponent classification. The abstract of the highly relevant recent preprint arXiv:2609.16966 was inspected, but its full text was not inspected; incidental tenth-power material not advertised in the abstract remains a residual originality risk. No independent validation is asserted.
